caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between shared sub-dimensions and eval perplexity (PPL) for two models. The x-axis is labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, with tick labels at 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and uses a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with tick labels at 10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 11.5, and 12.5. A line representing "MoHD" is depicted in blue with a circle marker and a solid line style. This line starts at approximately 10.8 at x=0/4, decreases to 10.4 at x=1/4, further declines to 10.3 at x=2/4, reaches a minimum of 10.2 at x=3/4, and rises slightly to approximately 10.4 at x=4/4. A line representing "Transformer" is depicted in red with a square marker and a dashed line style. This line maintains a relatively constant value of 11.6 across the entire x-axis, starting at approximately 11.6 at x=0/4 and ending at approximately 11.6 at x=4/4.
